violations.text:
Bowl or other container with no handle used to dispense food.
In rice bin

Commercially processed reduced oxygen packaged fish bearing a label indicating that it is to remain frozen until time of use no longer frozen and not removed from reduced oxygen package. See stop sale. Tuna in cook line drawer

Equipment and utensils not properly air-dried - wet nesting.
Clean containers in dish area

Time/temperature control for safety food packaged using a reduced oxygen method without a HACCP plan not removed from its package within 48 hours after packaging.
Raw steak in ROP

Heat strip failed to turn black to indicate the sanitization temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was achieved on the dish surface and/or high temperature holding thermometer did not reach 160F. Discontinue use of dishmachine for sanitizing and set up manual sanitization until dishmachine is repaired.
Chef set up sanitizer option on machine, reading 100ppm
Stop Sale issued due to food not being in a wholesome, sound condition.

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mashed potatoes 49f. Cold holding. Chef states item was pulled out of cooler for 30 minutes. Moved to rapid chill

Establishment packaging time/temperature control for safety food using a reduced oxygen method that requires a Process Waiver and the establishment does not have an approved Process Waiver and HACCP plan from the Division of Hotels and Restaurants. More information can be found at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/hotels-restaurants/special-process/. See stop sale.
Cooked chicken dated 8/6 and 8/8.
Today is 8/13.

Food manager certification expired. A list of accredited food manager certification examination providers can be found at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/hotels-restaurants/food-lodging/food-manager/
Exec. Chef expired. Chef is signed up for test

Food-contact surface soiled with food debris, mold-like substance or slime.
Can opener blade has old food debris.
Soda nozzle at prep station

Handwash sink not accessible for employee use at all times.

In bulk bins

Hood filters
